currentHash.description: The hash of the file's text as the page showed it (`file.read.hash`); null when the file does not exist.

point.description: A point of this file from `history.file` or `history.project`.

before.description:
The companion's copy "Before restore" of what was there; restoring it undoes the restore. Null when the
file did not exist.

hash.description: The hash of the file's text now (the next `baseHash`).

protected.description: The rule that marks the file as running code, if one does.

restored.description: The point now on disk (the one restored).

summary: Writes a history point's version over the file (or creates it again), after a copy "Before restore" of what is there.
